description: sflow_2d_amr_bar_nh_sub with the two levels in a box behind the wave generation zone (one patch per level, waves from the first steps): the level solves of the non-hydrostatic pressure measure the level-0 part of their preconditioner against the patch-local part alone and switch it off (the choice is printed with the SFLOW AMR line every 20 steps).
covers: sflow_amr::nh_level / nh_c0_choose: the level-0 part of the preconditioner of the level solves, measured and switched off
sflow_amr_nh: solve on the grids of the level window (nh_gw), patch-local preconditioner alone, level-0 multigrid matrix kept within a solve
